snippet.title: Horse Farm Simulator - Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Horse Farm Simulator is a relaxing simulation game that offers the opportunity to build and manage your own horse farm, while also providing enjoyable moments with unique horseback riding and farming experiences.

Horse Care 🐴

Change your horses' shoes, groom their coats, check their saddles, feed them regularly, don’t leave them hungry, keep them clean to protect their health, and don’t forget to clean up their poop.

Farming 🥕

Plant a variety of crops like carrots, alfalfa, and barley in your fields, harvest them on time, and use the yield to prepare nutritious feed for your horses—helping them stay healthy and strong.

Cafe Management ☕

In your humble café, prepare and sell a variety of food and drinks for the customers. Use the income you earn here to produce more products and grow your farm.

Riding & Race 🏇

Are you tired? Then take a leisurely ride around the town on your horse, or join a race with your horse. You can also earn money by betting on horse races if you prefer.

Grow ⏫

Make the right investments to grow your farm, add new products, and use your resources efficiently. Earn income by increasing the variety of your café or products based on customer demands, and use this income to develop your farm.

Step into the farm life of your dreams with Horse Farm Simulator! Build your farm, manage your business wisely, buy and customize your horses, show off your skills in races, satisfy your customers, and grow your farm. Come on, we need a farmer like you! #HorseFarmSimulator #horse #games #simulation 

Wishlist Now on Steam!
